plausibility_notes: Glass unwrapped at6:32 and unattended until6:44 gives12-minute exposure window. Poison could be deposited in empty glass and dissolve when punch added.
All guests appear able to reach sideboard, so access has not separated22 players.
Casey controls glass before and after open access and gives the timeline; treating this account as infallible would be an unstated innocence guarantee.
Jordan's damaged cabinet report supports theft without key access but is still partly a witness account; no authenticated observation of thief.
Barb's quiet response to theft of a hazardous poison during a public event is professionally hard to defend and remains a significant causal risk.
A new wrapped glass excludes earlier contamination only if wrap and chain of custody are reliable. No testing of wrapping or other museum-shop glasses yet.
The desk versus sideboard wording is mildly slippery: this release describes gift bottles as desk items while service surface is reception sideboard. Clarify whether these are the same surface.
